rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Prins Claus
Exhibition name: Rosalynn Carter
rows.Origin:
Bred by Gerrit De Ruiter (Netherlands, 1972).
Introduced in United States by Conard-Pyle (Star Roses) in 1978 as 'Rosalynn Carter'.
rows.Bloom: Coral-red, orange undertones. Strong, spice fragrance. 30 to 35 petals. Average diameter 3.75". Large, full (26-40 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, bushy, upright.

Height: 35" to 43" (90 to 110cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Vigorous.
